ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.08 - the setup access point is now WPA2 protected instead of open. Passphrase: fury4444. The device re-raises this AP ap_timeout (10s) after ANY loss of the station link, on a provisioned unit as well as a fresh one, and the captive portal accepts /wifisave from whoever joins - so while it was open, a brief router outage was enough for a passer-by to move a working garage door controller onto their own network. The passphrase is fleet-wide and printed on the unit, so it is a deterrent rather than a secret; the Improv-BLE authorizer added in .05 remains the stronger control. INSTALLERS: joining the setup network by hand now requires the passphrase. The Innovo app supplies it automatically and also displays it on the Connect step.
